mapper.select: select id, type, user_id, name, evaluation_scores, evaluation_desc, create_time from app_satisfaction_evaluation where id = #{id}

select ase.id,ase."type",ase.user_id,ase.evaluation_scores,ase.evaluation_desc,ase.create_time, su.user_id,su.user_name name,sd.dept_name from app_satisfaction_evaluation ase left join sys_user su on ase.user_id = su.user_id left join sys_dept sd on sd.dept_id = su.dept_id
and su.user_name like '${name}%'
and ase.evaluation_scores = #{evaluationScores}
and su.dept_id in (${deptIds})
order by id desc

select coalesce(CAST(AVG(ase.evaluation_scores) AS DECIMAL(10,2)), 0) avgScores from app_satisfaction_evaluation ase left join sys_user su on ase.user_id = su.user_id left join sys_dept sd on sd.dept_id = su.dept_id
and su.user_name like '${name}%'
and ase.evaluation_scores = #{evaluationScores}
and su.dept_id in (${deptIds})
mapper.insert: insert into app_satisfaction_evaluation(type, user_id, name, evaluation_scores, evaluation_desc, create_time) values (#{type}, #{userId}, #{name}, #{evaluationScores}, #{evaluationDesc}, #{createTime})

insert into app_satisfaction_evaluation(type, user_id, name, evaluation_scores, evaluation_desc, create_time) values
(#{entity.type}, #{entity.userId}, #{entity.name}, #{entity.evaluationScores}, #{entity.evaluationDesc}, #{entity.createTime})
on duplicate key update type = values(type), user_id = values(user_id), name = values(name), evaluation_scores = values(evaluation_scores), evaluation_desc = values(evaluation_desc), create_time = values(create_time)
